health.literalSeedTokens.tip: Panel settings still contain legacy seed-reference forms (leftover data imported by earlier versions): unexpanded reference tokens (channel/article/asset/theme; treated as unset at render time and silently broken), or the old alias-object form of channel references (renders fine, but export cannot tokenize them or collect their closure). Click "Repair seed tokens" to expand them in place into on-site IDs/URLs per the import convention; unresolvable ones are kept as-is and remain listed.
health.repairSeedTokens.confirm: Seed token literals in panel settings will be expanded in place per the import convention: channel/article references resolve to on-site IDs, asset tokens are copied, registered and expanded to this site's URLs, and theme placeholders expand to the source theme's asset prefix. This modifies panel data directly. Continue?
health.repairSeedTokens.partial: Repaired {panels} panels and expanded {expanded} tokens; {skipped} tokens could not be resolved and were kept as-is and remain listed
health.archivedPlacements.tip: Components orphaned by a theme switch are archived here automatically with their settings kept; they are restored automatically when you switch back to a theme that declares their page/region. You can also restore or delete them one by one, or clear them all at once.
health.archivedDelete.confirm: Delete archived component "{component}"? Its settings will be deleted as well and cannot be recovered.
health.archivedDeleteAll.confirm: Delete all {count} archived components? Their settings will be deleted as well and cannot be recovered.
health.structureResidue.tip: Residue left by out-of-band deletions: orphan panels (the component exists but is referenced by neither the published tree nor the draft tree; re-edit and save that region to clear them) or dangling references (the structure tree references a component that no longer exists; click "Prune dangling references" to remove them in one go).
health.pruneDangling.confirm: {count} references to deleted components will be removed from the structure tree. They no longer point to any data (pure residue), and pruning does not affect any in-use or archived component. Continue?
health.emptyRequiredRegions.tip: The manifest declares these regions but they have no published rows yet. Informational only, not an error.

health.stalePanelRefs.tip: The targets referenced by panel settings (channel/block/vote/article) have been deleted or moved to another site and are treated as unset at render time. For components that come from the theme seed and have not been modified, run "Import demo data" or "Update unmodified items" on the Themes page to repair them automatically; for the rest, open the panel in the builder and fix its settings.
health.unresolvableComponents.tip: The panel's component cannot be resolved in its track namespace chain (SSR ∪ core / active theme ∪ core) and renders as an empty placeholder. Usually caused by a theme switch or a component rename.
health.requiredSettingsMissing.tip: Enabled panels in published regions have required settings that are empty (mostly publishes that predate the required-field gate, or a theme update that added required fields to already-published panels); at render time they are silently filled with defaults or rendered empty. Fill in the settings in the builder and publish again.
